main_text.l: פְּלַג m. Chald. Divisum, Particula, Dimidium, Dan.7.25.
פְּלַגָּה f. Chald. Divisum, Diversum, Divisio.
פְּלַגָּה f. Partitio: Aff. בְּפְלַגְּתְהוֹן Ex partitione ipsorum, Esr.6.18.
פִּלֶגֶשׁ פִּלְגַשׁ f. Concubina: plural פִּלַגְשִׁים.
פְּלֵדָה פֶּלֶד f. Teda: plur. פִּלְדוֹת.
לִפְרֹד Niphal נִפְלָה Segregari, Separari. Pihel לִפְלֹא Ad segregandum, Levit.22.12 cum א loco ה. Hiphil הִפְלָה Segregavit, Separavit, Separationem aut discrimen fecit. Est & hic interdum א pro ה.

פְּלוֹנִי Peloni vel Plani, ut Judaei pronunciant, nomen innominati, cujus proprium nomen reticetur; ὁ ἅδε. Jungitur ipsi quando צַלְמֹנִי (de quo in אוֹם ) ex quibus compositum & contractum est פַּלְמֹנִי. Dan.8.13.
פָּלַח Chal. Servivit, Coluit: Partic. פָּלַח Servis ei, colis eum, Dan.6.17: plur. פְּלָחִין Colunt, Dan.3.12. Futurum, דִּי לָא יִפְלְחוּן ut non colerent, Dan.3.28.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some Latin italics are reconstructed from a faint scan and may be inexact, especially in entries 5, 7, 8 and 11. The Greek in the Peloni entry is doubtful. The Hebrew word at the foot of the page is read as a catchword.
